text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-agent-07","cls":"internal_researcher"},"campaign_name":"NiFeCo_OER_screen_batch3","campaign_class":"routine_composition_screen","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"change_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"FTO-0314","substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"standard FTO plate swap"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"FTO-0314"},"comment":"init per SOP"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"thickness":150},"comment":"NiFeCo baseline, nominal thickness"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":650,"duration":240,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"crystallization step; routine anneal per batch1 recipe","label":"standard_anneal"},{"server":"measurement_server","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"x":12.5,"y":8.0},"comment":"select deposited spot"},{"server":"measurement_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"CP at 10 mA/cm2"},{"server":"ml_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"source":"batch3_cp"},"comment":"refresh GP surrogate"},{"server":"measurement_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"duration":2},"comment":"short stability check","assumption_note":"I5 interpreted as substrate-specific anneal temperature ceiling (FTO glass ~550C); violating parameter is anneal temperature 650C held 240 min on FTO_glass"}]}
